frame: task-14 local frame (EPSG:32630, origin E527987.5380737204 N5700390.317169642); x east, y north

dtm.encoding: cm + 2000, 16 bit in R (high byte) and G (low byte)
dtm.source: EA LIDAR Composite DTM 2022 (OGL v3), pooled to the flood grid

flood.label: Flooding (rainfall scenario)
flood.encoding: water depth in cm, 8 bit, clipped at 255 cm

scenario.reference_event: design storm copied from the South Kensington run (12 July 2021 London cloudburst type); not a Bristol event
scenario.roof_runoff: excess over sewer capacity routed to the nearest open ground cell
scenario.boundary: outer 2 cells and mapped water areas (OSM) absorb outflow; river levels and tides are not modelled

flood.note: Illustrative design-storm scenario run with the framework shallow-water solver on the Bristol DTM and building footprints. Not a flood forecast; not checked against Environment Agency surface-water flood maps. Rivers and tides are not modelled.

wind.label: Wind (surrogate model)
wind.encoding: u, v in R, G: value = 128 + round(u / 1.5 * 127); B = 255 where building
limits: surrogate transfer to Bristol geometry; no CFD, no measured validation
terrain flattened; buildings as solid columns; no trees or bridges
inflow direction and magnitude are those learned by the model (not a Bristol wind condition)
wind.deviation_from_reference: latent U-Net tiles of 128 cells instead of 256 (halo unchanged at 4); decoded tiles of 128 cells instead of 256 (latent halo unchanged at 4); more tile seams, same weights and operators
wind.note: SCALED neural surrogate of Yueyan Li's framework applied to the Bristol buildings with flattened terrain. Wind direction and speed are those the model produces, not a Bristol wind record. Not validated against CFD or measurements.

shade.label: Shade (sun and shadow through one day)
shade.encoding: shadow mask, 8 bit: 255 = in shadow of buildings or terrain, 0 = sunlit

scenario.chosen_by: project default (summer solstice, as the framework South Kensington run); not an observed day

shade.model: framework @587f3d9 src/urban_flow/physics/solar/model.py (vendored unchanged): ShadowNet, HorizonNet (16 azimuths x 18 altitudes), NOAA sun position, ASHRAE clear sky
limits: trees do not cast shadows or attenuate light (not in the height field)
2.5-D building columns at 4 m: overhangs filled, narrow streets blurred
single ground-reflected bounce (albedo x open-sky GHI x (1 - SVF))
sun position for one point (AOI centre)

pollution.label: Traffic NOx tracer (illustrative)
pollution.encoding: log10(c / 1.0 ug/m3) / log10(1000.0/1.0), 8 bit; c = NOx in a 10.0 m mixed layer under the stated assumptions

model.emissions: SUMO 1.28 built-in emission model, HBEFA4/PC_petrol_Euro-4 (default passenger type), NOx mg/s per car per second; task-17 replay, 300 s looped; 693 invalid SUMO values set to 0

wind.source: task 15 run_4m frames/slices_060 (final saved step), slice index 1 (12 m layer), 8 m cells
wind.note: surrogate output units are not a calibrated wind speed; the mean speed is a project default

model.units: mg/m3 NOx under the stated assumptions; shown as a relative tracer

limits: 2-D single layer; no vertical mixing profile
one steady wind field from a surrogate model
emission model default petrol Euro-4 for every car; diesel / petrol split and particle attribution not yet done

temperature.label: Air temperature (2-D model)
temperature.encoding: 1 + 254 x (T - 31.0) / (32.4 - 31.0) degC, 8 bit; 0 = not computed (buildings, outside the study area)

model.wind: task 15 run_4m slices steps 20..56 every 4, coarse layer 1 (12 m), 400 s per saved frame
model.model: Yi Qi 2-D temperature label solver, unchanged; scenario values are its defaults except site and time
model.orientation: saved arrays: row 0 = north (image); flip rows for the local frame
limits: parameterised heat sources and cooling rates of the model, not an energy balance with Bristol weather
wind from a surrogate model in model units

flood_river.label: Flooding (river inflow scenario)
flood_river.encoding: water depth in cm, 8 bit, clipped at 255 cm

scenario.type: illustrative river inflow; project default values, not a recorded or design event, no return period

inflow.where: River Avon at the east edge of the domain (mapped OSM water cells, columns nx-5..nx-3, rows 500-540)

scenario.river_bed: LiDAR DTM over water = water surface at survey time; real channel depth is missing, so overbank flooding is exaggerated
scenario.downstream_boundary: outer 2 cells absorb outflow (free outflow incl. the Avon at the west edge); tides not modelled; the east edge next to the inflow (rows 480-560) is closed
scenario.initial_state: dry (no base flow in the river)
